kpis.description_fr: DRAM (incl. HBM3E AI). ~73% du CA Micron. Cycle haut tiré par AI/datacenter HBM.
kpis.description_en: DRAM (incl. HBM3E AI). ~73% of Micron revenue. Up-cycle driven by AI/datacenter HBM.

kpis.description_fr: HBM3E pour AI accelerators (NVIDIA H100/B100). Catalyst structurel, supply chain SK Hynix + Samsung + Micron.
kpis.description_en: HBM3E for AI accelerators (NVIDIA H100/B100). Structural catalyst, SK Hynix + Samsung + Micron supply chain.

kpis.description_fr: NAND flash (SSD enterprise + mobile + consumer). Recovery cycle 2024.
kpis.description_en: NAND flash (enterprise SSD + mobile + consumer). 2024 cycle recovery.

kpis.description_fr: Croissance bits livrés segment compute/datacenter. AI demand structural.
kpis.description_en: Compute/datacenter segment bit growth. Structural AI demand.

kpis_story.description_fr: HBM4 sampling clients clés AI fin 2025, production volume 2026. ~50% performance boost vs HBM3E. Catalyst maintien parts marché vs SK Hynix.
kpis_story.description_en: HBM4 sampling to key AI customers late 2025, volume production 2026. ~50% performance boost vs HBM3E. Market share retention catalyst vs SK Hynix.

kpis_story.description_fr: Construction megafabs Idaho (Boise) + Clay NY : 100Mds$ engagés sur 20 ans, soutien CHIPS Act (~6Mds$). Sécurité supply DRAM domestique US.
kpis_story.description_en: Idaho (Boise) + Clay NY megafabs construction: $100B over 20 years, CHIPS Act support (~$6B). US domestic DRAM supply security.

_notes: Micron = memory pure-play DRAM + NAND + HBM. Fiscal year fin août.
